script: A small hand-folded paper boat of grey-white newsprint, edges softened and ink slightly bleeding from the damp, drifting on shallow floodwater that has swallowed a city street gutter; wet asphalt, submerged curb lines, drifting leaves and bits of litter, blurred grey building facades and parked-car reflections in the water around it. The boat drifts slowly forward with the gentle gutter current, bobbing softly and yawing a few degrees side to side; raindrops land near it, sending concentric ripples that nudge and rock the hull; the soggy paper flexes faintly with each small wave. Macro lens at water level, very shallow depth of field with the boat's bow as the focal plane and the background dissolved into soft bokeh; slow lateral tracking shot gliding alongside the boat at close range, occasional subtle focus pull from the hull to raindrop ripples; 24fps cinematic character with gentle motion blur. Overcast melancholy; desaturated cool palette of slate greys, muted blue-greens and washed paper white; soft diffused shadowless daylight, damp matte textures, faint filmic grain, fine-art cinematic realism with a quiet, lonely mood
